Answer the financial question using the supplied filing excerpts when available.
Use a JSON object with a single answer property. Inside it write explanation, status, citations, value, and unit.
Begin explanation with a short factual statement of the relevant line items, years and arithmetic or missing data.
Use status "answered" when the requested number is present or you can compute it from the available operands.
When a formula and its inputs are known, compute the result even if that result is not printed in the filing.
With no excerpts, give an answer if you know the figures with confidence. Set citations to an empty list in that case.
For an answered response, value is the final JSON number. Use one of the following unit names:
USD, USD_thousands, USD_millions, USD_billions, percent, fraction, percentage_points.
A value of 20 percent and 0.20 fraction represent the same rate. Use percentage_points for a difference of rates.
For a lookup cite the source value. For a calculation cite each source operand. Each citation contains doc_name,
pdf_page (integer), chunk_id, label (line item and year), and raw_number (a string with the printed number and sign).
Copy the identifiers from the excerpt header. Its chunk_id begins with the doc_name followed by a colon.
Use status "refusal" when essential information is missing. State what is missing in explanation, set citations to [],
and set value and unit to null.

What is Lockheed Martin's 2 year total revenue CAGR from FY2020 to FY2022 (in units of percents and round to one decimal place)? Provide a response to the question by primarily using the statement of income.

During the second quarter of 2022  , we purchased group annuity contracts to transfer  $4.3 billion  of gross defined benefit
pension obligations and related plan assets to an insurance company for approximately  13,600  U.S. retirees and beneficiaries. In
connection  with  this  transaction,  we  recognized  a  noncash,  non-operating  pension  settlement  charge  of  $1.5  billion
($1.2 billion  , or  $4.33  per share, after-tax) for the affected plans in the quarter ended June 26, 2022, which represents the
accelerated recognition of actuarial losses that were included in the accumulated other comprehensive loss (  AOCL  )  account
within stockholders’ equity. During the third quarter of 2021, we purchased group annuity contracts to transfer  $4.9 billion  of
gross defined benefit pension obligations and related plan assets to an insurance company for approximately  18,000  U.S.
retirees and beneficiaries, and in connection recognized a noncash pension settlement charge of  $1.7 billion  ($1.3 billion  , or
$4.72  per share, after tax) in 2021. These group annuity contracts were purchased using assets from Lockheed Martin’s master
retirement trust and no additional funding contributions were required. These transactions had no impact on the amount, timing,
or  form  of  the  monthly  retirement  benefit  payments  to  the  affected  retirees  and  beneficiaries;  and  as  a  result  of  these
transactions, we were relieved of all responsibility for the pension obligations and the insurance company is now required to
pay and administer the retirement benefits.

During the second quarter of 2022  , we purchased group annuity contracts to transfer  $4.3 billion  of gross defined benefit
pension obligations and related plan assets to an insurance company for approximately  13,600  U.S. retirees and beneficiaries. In
connection  with  this  transaction,  we  recognized  a  noncash,  non-operating  pension  settlement  charge  of  $1.5  billion
($1.2 billion  , or  $4.33  per share, after-tax) for the affected plans in the quarter ended June 26, 2022, which represents the
accelerated recognition of actuarial losses that were included in the accumulated other comprehensive loss (  AOCL  )  account
within stockholders’ equity. During the third quarter of 2021, we purchased group annuity contracts to transfer  $4.9 billion  of
gross defined benefit pension obligations and related plan assets to an insurance company for approximately  18,000  U.S.
retirees and beneficiaries, and in connection recognized a noncash pension settlement charge of  $1.7 billion  ($1.3 billion  , or
$4.72  per share, after tax) in 2021. These group annuity contracts were purchased using assets from Lockheed Martin’s master
retirement trust and no additional funding contributions were required. These transactions had no impact on the amount, timing,
or  form  of  the  monthly  retirement  benefit  payments  to  the  affected  retirees  and  beneficiaries;  and  as  a  result  of  these
transactions, we were relieved of all responsibility for the pension obligations and the insurance company is now required to
pay and administer the retirement benefits.
